headline: A small follow-up — naming, and a quiet housekeeping pass on your activity log.

items.prompt_template:
Quick one-time setup — want to give me a name? Many people find it more natural to refer to their assistant by name. The default is `{default_name}` but you can pick anything (or skip). To set it, type:

  - `name my AI Penelope`  (or any name you prefer)
  - `name my AI skip`  (I'll stay nameless)

The name shows up in your scheduled briefs, signatures, and our conversations. You can change it any time with `name my AI [new name]`.
Housekeeping — I tightened up your activity log so a few new kinds of notes I write are recognized cleanly. You won't see a difference; your weekly audit will just run quieter going forward.
